text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hiya, I'm Maruzensky. I'm stoked to meet you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You know that sweet feeling you get when the wind blows on your face as you run? That always gets me real jazzed!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna crank my speed up like a supercar, so make sure you're watching closely! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
